title: Topic 5.1: Commanding good and forbidding evil

pages.lesson:
LESSON: COMMANDING GOOD AND FORBIDDING EVIL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1: Commanding good and forbidding evil
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Commanding good and forbidding evil, part of Akhlaq (Moral Teachings) in Grade 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why should a Muslim command good and forbid evil? 2. How can today’s Muslims command good and forbid evil?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss ways of commanding good and forbidding evil in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint,

2. research on the significance of commanding good and forbidding evil and make notes,

3. discuss ways of commanding good and forbidding evil and present in class,

4. role-play the best ways of commanding good and forbidding evil. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss ways of commanding good and forbidding evil in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint,
2. research on the significance of commanding good and forbidding evil and make notes,
3. discuss ways of commanding good and forbidding evil and present in class,
4. role-play the best ways of commanding good and forbidding evil. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Commanding good and forbidding evil together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners research on the significance of

commanding good and forbidding evil and make presentations.

• Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking enhanced through dramatization of the best ways of

commanding good and forbidding evil.

good and forbidding evil in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint.

Values:

● Social justice is enhanced through discussing ways of commanding good and forbidding evil in groups and presenting on

charts/PowerPoint.

● Unity is enhanced through discussing ways of commanding good and forbidding evil.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

● Patriotism is enhanced as learners research on the significance of commanding good and forbidding evil.

Link to other subjects

● Creative Arts and Sports as learners dramatize the best ways of commanding good and forbidding evil.
